next.reason: 1985 Permanent Error, including 'Any specified exception procedures are executed' and 'remains in effect for all subsequent input-output operations on the file unless an implementor-defined technique is invoked', is word for word in §2023:9.1.13.1 ('The permanent error condition remains in effect for all subsequent input-output operations on the file unless an implementor-defined technique is invoked'), read in the transcription; the recheck's OPEN came only from not seeing it. Catalogued carriers: the class-3 values (§2023:9.1.13.6 GR1 'A permanent error exists and no further information is available', through 39) and USE procedures run 'upon the unsuccessful execution of an input-output operation' (§2023:14.9.49.4 GR6).
